label: Crispest — Karl_K's specific P3 leakage example
commentary: Karl_K identified face-up P3 leakage in the top and bottom central V regions between the windmills of 'Crispest', judging it the worst of the initial three (#9), and called the crown relatively low (#10). This is a specifically localized expert diagnosis, unlike generic dark-pixel suspicion. The complete original D360 256-frame sequence is archived under #64, but not automatically playable as a Learning Corner reference until its evidence is explicitly linked and validated.
